incident-bot: PAGED: P1 - elevated 'incorrect output' reports on /v1/generate (hosted) - auto-created #incidents thread. paging @oncall-jordan

oncall-jordan: ack, I'm on the page. grabbing logs and will triage

maya (oncall): quick summary: spikes in 'content_mismatch' alerts at ~18:02 UTC. many responses are 200 but content is stale/incorrect. initial correlation with prefix cache invalidation events in pool-us-west-2.

lee (eng-runtime): logs show prefix/KV cache serving entries with older KV sequence ids for tenant t-134. repro locally: request prefix "user:prompt:abc" returns previous output.

maya (oncall): customer impact = incorrect outputs (not latency). A few enterprise tenants reported product-level failures. Prioritize correctness: recommend disabling prefix-level caching for affected model (gpt-open-13b) and enable KV bypass for strict reads.

olga (ops): proposed live mitigations:
- apply tenant-level quota cap to throttle noisy tenant t-134
- toggle prefix-cache off for gpt-open-13b in the affected hostpool
- enable kv-bypass for reads to force authoritative fetch
- route a fraction of traffic to fallback model to lower pressure

lee (eng-runtime): applying config via control plane now:
```
redwoodctl routes update --route /v1/generate --model gpt-open-13b --prefix-cache off --kv-bypass on --region us-west-2
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started by lee at 2026-03-15T18:20Z. rolling config to 3/5 nodes in hostpool-us-west-2

maya (oncall): also applying quota cap for tenant t-134:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/v1/tenants/t-134/quotas" \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
 -d '{"tokens_per_minute":2000}'
```

kim (cs): notified assigned CS reps; opening support tickets and sending mitigation notes to affected customers. drafting status page blurb.

lee (eng-runtime): after gating ~50% traffic to fallback and disabling prefix cache in the pool, the content_mismatch rate dropped ~80%, but a small tail remains. plan: expand disable across region and run KV reindex to flush stale entries.

deploy-bot: config change completed at 2026-03-15T18:27Z. 15/15 nodes in targeted subset updated. Observability warming.

observability-bot: Metric update: content_mismatch_rate (gpt-open-13b@us-west-2) decreased from 12.1% -> 1.9% over 8 minutes. latency stable.

oncall-jordan: handing escalation to eng-runtime (lee) for root cause and remediation. oncall stands down unless new regressions appear.

lee (eng-runtime): starting KV scan/reindex job to identify stale KV prefixes and fix invalidation race. ETA ~2h. starting dry-run: `python tools/kv_reindex.py --prefix 'user:prompt:' --dry-run` -> then full run.

olga (ops): updating status page:
"We are investigating incorrect outputs for a subset of customers. A temporary mitigation (prefix cache disabled for the affected model and tenant quota caps) is in place. Impact has been reduced; updates every 30 minutes."

kim (cs): sent initial customer notices and added follow-ups for 2 enterprise customers. Next update scheduled +30m.

maya (oncall): post-incident owners: eng-runtime + infra + product-ops. Action items: permanent fix for cache invalidation ordering, add canary test for prefix-cache toggles, region-wide KV consistency checks, playbook update for cache-bypass.

oncall-jordan: summary of mitigations: quota cap on t-134, traffic shaping to fallback model, prefix-cache OFF for gpt-open-13b in us-west-2, KV bypass enabled. Current impact: greatly reduced; small residual mismatch tail. Next steps: KV reindex + root-cause and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
